newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq May short-interest climbs to 1.53 bln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq May short-interest climbs to 1.53 bln shrs.

text.p: The Nasdaq stock market said Tuesday that short interest in the 4,099 Nasdaq National Market securities totaled 1.53 billion shares for the month ended May 15, versus 1.48 billion shares of 4,085 issues in the previous month.

Nasdaq, the National Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotation system, added that that short interest in all its 5,531 issues, which includes the SmallCap market stocks, totaled 1.58 billion shares for the month ended mid-May, up from 1.533 billion shares of 5,506 issues in the previous month.
